60-019.r: Sleeping sickness (human African trypanosomiasis) → protozoan Trypanosoma brucei (gambiense, rhodesiense); spread by bite of tse-tse fly (Glossina).

60-020.r: Sleeping sickness is NOT mosquito-borne (spread by tse-tse fly); dengue, filariasis, malaria, Zika, chikungunya are mosquito-borne.

60-021.r: Unsafe drinking water + poor sanitation → three main communicable diseases of developing countries: malaria, acute diarrhoea, schistosomiasis.

60-022.r: Taeniasis → intestinal tapeworm infection by Taenia solium (pork), T. saginata (beef), T. asiatica (Asian); cysts in brain → neurocysticercosis (NCC). Both statements true.

60-023.r: Leander Paes, 2003 → a cyst found in his brain (cysticercus granuloma, caused by tapeworm larva), not a tumour.

61-001.r: Night blindness is NOT genetic (vitamin A deficiency); albinism, haemophilia and colour blindness are genetic diseases.

61-002.r: Phenylketonuria (PKU) → inborn error of metabolism = inherited lack of enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (phenylalanine → tyrosine); recessive trait; causes mental idiocy.

61-004.r: Bubble Baby Disease = SCID (severe combined immunodeficiency), rare genetic disorder of T and B cells; baby is kept in a germ-free plastic bubble.

61-005.r: Haemophilia → hereditary sex-linked disease; women carry it, men suffer; blood does not clot (lack of thromboplastin); bleeder's disease, 'royal disease' (Queen Victoria).
61-005.h: Queen Victoria carried it to royal families: women carry, men bleed.

61-010.r: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) → common gut disorder, NOT genetic; Down syndrome, haemophilia, sickle cell anaemia are hereditary.

61-011.r: Trisomy 21 (extra copy of chromosome 21) → Down syndrome (Mongolian idiocy).

61-014.r: Down syndrome → change in the NUMBER of chromosomes: chromosome 21 has 3 copies instead of 2, total 47 (2x + 1).
61-014.t: Number change (Down syndrome), not a change in chromosome structure or DNA structure.

61-015.r: Muscular dystrophy → X-linked hereditary disease caused by a recessive gene on the sex (X) chromosome.

61-016.r: Haemophilia → genetic disease; Diabetes → hormonal disorder; Rickets → deficiency disease; Ringworm → fungal infection.

61-017.r: Hereditary: colour blindness, haemophilia, sickle cell anaemia. Bacterial: diphtheria, pneumonia, leprosy, syphilis, gonorrhoea, plague. Viral: AIDS, polio, Japanese B encephalitis.

61-018.r: Men get colour blindness more → X-linked recessive; men have only one X-chromosome, so one faulty gene is enough; women have two.

61-019.r: Wrong pair: Vitamin A – colour blindness. Vitamin A lack → night blindness; colour blindness is genetic. Thiamine–beriberi, ascorbic acid–scurvy, vitamin K–clotting are correct.

61-020.r: Colour-blind man × normal woman → normal sons, carrier daughters (0% colour-blind children); disease shows in sons of daughters (about 50%).
61-020.h: Skips a generation: grandfather → carrier daughter → grandson.

61-022.r: Colour-blind woman × normal man → sons colour blind; daughters only carriers (not affected).

61-023.r: Thalassemia → hereditary blood disorder; body cannot make enough haemoglobin → severe anaemia.

62-001.r: Muscle fatigue → build-up of lactic acid (by-product of anaerobic metabolism) in muscles.

62-002.r: Arthritis (gout) → deposition of uric acid crystals (monosodium urate) in joints.

62-003.r: High uric acid in blood (hyperuricemia) → gout: sudden burning pain, stiffness and swelling in a joint.

62-004.r: Dropsy (body swelling) → mustard oil adulterated with argemone oil (also cyanide parts, white colour); rice husk in oil is NOT a cause.

62-005.r: Argemone mexicana (poppy family Papaveraceae) seeds look like mustard (Brassica nigra) → common adulterant; about 1% causes disease; last major Indian outbreak 1998.

62-006.r: Cancer → abnormal cell growth beginning from a single cell that can invade or spread; benign tumours do not spread.

62-007.r: Carcinogens → physical, chemical or biological agents that turn normal cells into cancerous (neoplastic) cells by causing DNA mutations.
62-007.t: Carcinogen = cause of cancer; metastasis = spread of cancer.

62-008.r: Anthophobia → fear of flowers (Greek anthos = flower, phobos = fear).
62-008.h: Anthos = flower, as in 'anther' of a flower.

62-009.r: Hysteria → mainly in young (unmarried) women; symptoms: anxiety, discomfort, faintness.

62-010.r: Silicosis → lung disease from inhaling tiny bits of silica (found in sand, rock, quartz).

62-011.r: Thyroid malfunction → iodine deficiency; goitre = enlarged thyroid; less thyroxine and triiodothyronine made.

62-012.r: Anaemia → iron deficiency; Goitre → iodine deficiency; Night blindness → vitamin A deficiency; Beri-beri → vitamin B deficiency.

62-016.r: Polished rice diet → beriberi (thiamine, vitamin B1 deficiency), since milling and polishing remove husk, bran and germ.

62-019.r: Blue baby syndrome → excess nitrate in drinking water; nitrate → nitrite → methemoglobin in blood, which cannot carry oxygen.
62-019.t: Nitrate = blue baby; fluoride = fluorosis; arsenic and chloride are distractors.

62-022.r: Heart attack sequence: plaque (fibrous tissue + cholesterol) → clots carried into coronary arteries → vessel narrows → too little blood and oxygen (2, 4, 1, 3).

62-023.r: Golden Hour → critical first one hour after onset of a heart attack; most deaths occur in it if untreated.

62-024.r: Beta-blockers (beta-adrenoceptor blocking agents) → used for heart attack, hypertension, angina, abnormal heart rhythms.

62-025.r: Potassium (K) → essential to regulate heartbeat; also helps muscles, nerves and kidney filtering.

62-026.r: Potassium deficiency → low blood pressure (sources: flesh, milk, cereals, fruits, vegetables).

62-027.r: Albumin (plasma protein) in urine → kidney failure risk. Urine ≈ 91-96% water, about 2.6% urea, 0.3% creatinine.

62-028.r: Long fasting → kidneys are affected most.

62-029.r: Nuclear medicines → radioisotopes (radioactive isotopes) used to study organ function and treat diseases.

62-030.r: Arsenic-74 → tumour; Cobalt-60 → cancer; Iodine-131 → thyroid activity; Sodium-24 → blood disorder.

62-031.r: Wrong pair: Gold-198 – retinal disorders; Gold-198 treats cancer. Correct: Cobalt-60 internal neoplasm, Iodine-131 thyroid neoplasm, Phosphorus-32 leukaemia.

62-032.r: Radio-sodium → measures speed of blood flow in the human body.

62-033.r: Leukaemia → blood cancer starting in bone marrow; abnormal increase in white blood cells.

62-034.r: Blood cancer (leukaemia) control → Phosphorus-32 and Cobalt-60 both used; book gives both (c) and (d), so 'more than one' in BPSC form.

62-036.r: Cobalt-60 (synthetic isotope) → used in radiation treatment because it emits gamma (γ) rays.

62-037.r: Arsenic-74 → detects tumours; Sodium-24 → blood clots; Iodine-131 → thyroid activity; Cobalt-60 → treats cancer; Carbon-14 → dating organic material.
62-037.t: Detect tumour = Arsenic-74; treat cancer = Cobalt-60.

62-039.r: Muscle ache treatment → infrared radiation (heat therapy; helps cells repair; eases muscle and joint pain, spasm, stiffness).

62-040.r: Oncogene → abnormal gene that makes cells turn cancerous; first identified SRC (sarcoma) in 1970, from Rous sarcoma virus of chickens.

62-041.r: Cancer → uncontrolled multiplication of cells; they take nutrients from normal cells, which die, finally causing death.

62-042.r: Metastasis → spread of cancer cells through blood or lymphatic system to other organs (local invasion → intravasation → circulation).

62-043.r: Ionised radiation → can both cause and cure cancer, depending on intensity and use (photon and particle radiation used in therapy).

62-044.r: Harmful radiation → affects eyes most, brain least (brain is least susceptible).

62-045.r: Relief from body aches → infrared radiation (thermal therapy: warms tissues, raises blood flow, relaxes muscles); wavelength longer than visible light.

62-046.r: Book's answer: Intensity Modulated Radiotherapy (IMRT) → most recent cancer therapy; precise radiation dose to target, used for nearly every solid tumour.

62-047.r: Interferons (IFNs) → signalling proteins released by host cells against viruses, bacteria, tumour cells; used to control cancer (IFN alpha 2 for blood cancer).

62-048.r: Carcinoma (cancer of epithelial tissue) → treated with platinum compounds: cisplatin, carboplatin, oxaliplatin.

62-049.r: Cerebral palsy → brain disorder that appears in infancy or early childhood, permanently affecting body movement and muscle co-ordination.

62-050.r: Alzheimer's disease → affects the brain: nerve cell death and tissue loss; brain shrinks.

62-051.r: Alzheimer's disease → linked to β-amyloid precursor protein.

62-052.r: Arvid Carlsson (Swedish) → dopamine work led to Parkinson's disease drugs; Nobel Prize (Physiology or Medicine) 2000 with Eric Kandel, Paul Greengard.

62-053.r: Scratching eases itching → stimulates nerves that make the brain raise antihistaminic chemicals (they block histamine of allergic reactions).

62-054.r: Anosmia → loss of the sense of smell (from nasal congestion, cold, allergy, sinus infection).

62-055.r: Correct: Dyspnoea → shortness of breath; Anosmia → loss of smell. Swapped: Anorexia = eating disorder, Insomnia = sleep disorder.

62-056.r: Bulimia (bulimia nervosa) → eating disorder: secret binge eating then purging; person does not know when to stop eating.
62-056.t: Don't confuse bulimia (over-eating) with anorexia nervosa (opposite).

62-057.r: Sleep apnea → breathing briefly and repeatedly stops (or becomes shallow) during sleep.

62-058.r: Khaira → zinc deficiency; Anaemia → iron deficiency; Goitre → iodine deficiency; Scurvy → vitamin C deficiency.

62-059.r: Knock-knee syndrome (genu valgum: knees bend in and touch) → fluoride pollution (fluoride toxicity).

62-061.r: Wrong pair: Fluoride ion – indigestion; excess fluoride → fluorosis (yellow teeth, enamel damage). Correct: mercury–Minamata, cadmium–Itai-Itai, nitrate–blue baby syndrome.

62-062.r: Minamata disease (Minamata city, Kumamoto, Japan; found 1956) → methyl mercury from Chisso factory wastewater, eaten in fish and shellfish.

62-066.r: Itai-Itai disease → chronic cadmium poisoning (Toyama Prefecture, Japan; mass poisoning 1950, first reported 1912).

62-068.r: Asthma → caused by allergy (immune reaction to pollen, dust mites, mould spores, medicines).

62-069.r: Diet of only milk, egg and bread → no vitamin C → scurvy (spongy bleeding gums, loose teeth).

62-070.r: Scurvy → vitamin C deficiency; Indian gooseberry (amla), the best vitamin C source, helps treat it.

62-073.r: Lukoskin (DRDO herbal ointment and oral liquid) → treatment of leucoderma.

62-074.r: DRDO polyherbal products: Amtooth (toothache), Lukoskin (leucoderma), Eczit (eczema). Nocdurna is NOT from DRDO (a prescription medicine).

62-075.r: Malaria → blood cells; Filaria → lymph node; Encephalitis → brain; Leukaemia → bone marrow.
